_readme: Clinic gallery. PHOTOS AND CAPTIONS TO BE CONFIRMED WITH CLIENT: the captions below are neutral placeholders. To add a photo: put the file (JPG, PNG or WebP, at least 800px wide) in assets/img/gallery/, set its path as 'src' below, then run: node src/optimize-gallery.mjs && node src/build.mjs. 'focus' sets which part stays visible when the photo is cropped to 4:3. Leave 'src' as null to show a placeholder tile. Never use photos of another clinic. The first photo shows large.
